block_policy.quotation_policy: all existing evidence, in source order; no query-based sentence selection
block_policy.split_policy: longest fitting prefix; prefer last fitting sentence punctuation, then clause punctuation, then Unicode character boundary
block_policy.normalization: collapse quotation whitespace only; preserve exact quote and offsets separately
block_policy.secondary_limitation: more blocks provide more opportunities for a high maximum
block_policy.document_encoding: one unique document per call, batch_size=1; deduplicate exact text
block_policy.pool_comparison: 25 and 28 candidate rankings derived from the same saved image/document vectors and score table

notes: Historical image/document vectors and scores are retained exactly when reuse is enabled.
Only missing baseline label documents and added queries require encoding in this version.
All, historical and added subsets are reported separately; added queries are reviewed development data.
Mean is primary; max is secondary. No candidate text selection or default adoption follows observed scores.
Timing excludes inherited work and is not a speed benchmark; U2 remains paused.
